Behavior complement is (X times Y) minus R. Specifically outputs violating Unreachable rows remain empty; start remains singleton. Reachable rows shrink monotonically, remain supersets of true dominators, and satisfy predecessor intersection at termination. are excluded; a valid-input Err or a wrong successful witness is excluded. Resource, cycle and structural rejections are determined before algorithmic output.
